ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale: your query is a benign code-review task with no harm-adjacent or distasteful content, so the desensitization profiles that distinguish the two models don't apply. That leaves raw capability as the deciding factor, and Petrel-235B scores higher on every relevant axis — coding/reasoning (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, GPQA 64.1 vs 54.3), instruction-following (IFEval 89.8 vs 85.6), and Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs 81.6, a meaningful gap beyond run-to-run variance). Cost, latency, and context window are identical across the fleet, so there's no tradeoff against choosing the stronger model.
